description: Create natural, relationship-aware wishes through adaptive discovery, tone calibration, self-review, and conversational refinement.

defaultPrompt: Help me write a birthday wish. Ask for basics and behavioral context before drafting.
Write a warm milestone-birthday message and calibrate humor to our real relationship.
Refine this wish so it sounds natural and like me.
interface.longDescription: WishCraft helps you write birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, farewells, congratulations, festivals, thank-yous, and other occasion messages. It gathers the missing basics and 3-6 adaptive behavioral details in one compact round, then calibrates warmth, humor, and emotional intensity to the relationship, audience, and boundaries. It uses only details you provide, drafts natural channel-appropriate copy, checks for cliches and awkward AI-like phrasing, and refines the message from your edits during the current conversation.

name: wishcraft
